patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Bypasses startup delays and collapses all ad containers.

patches.name: Custom Cartographic Region
patches.description: Adds dynamic cartographic region overrides to Google Maps.

patches.name: Hybrid Theme (Dark Menus, Light Map)
patches.description: Allows toggling a light map canvas while keeping app UI in Dark Mode via Customizations menu.

patches.name: Fix Random Subreddit Button
patches.description: Reroutes all Random buttons to pick from a custom pre-loaded list of thousands of subreddits.
